name: MIB E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1

function.text: MIB1 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase MIB1. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in endocytosis and protein ubiquitination.
